title: Nesterov Accelerated Gradient Optimizer
prompt: Implement the Nesterov Accelerated Gradient (NAG) optimizer update step function. Your function should take the current parameter value, gradient function, and velocity as inputs, and return the updated parameter value and new velocity. The function should use the "look-ahead" approach where momentum is applied before computing the gradient, and should handle both scalar and array inputs.
